16.08.2024 WPSB No. 498 of 2024 
Hon’ble Ritu Bahri, C.J.
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J. 
1. Mr. Abhijay Negi and Ms. Snigdha 
Tiwari, learned counsel for the petitioner. 
2. Mr. Devendra Singh Bora, learned 
Standing Counsel for the State / respondent 
Nos. 1 and 2. 
3. Counsel for the State has referred to a 
letter dated 05.07.2024, whereby the 
petitioner had sought transfer himself and 
had highlighted the reasons why he is 
seeking transfer. However, as per counsel 
for the petitioner, the petitioner had sought 
transfer on three stations, viz., Haridwar, 
Dehradun and Kalsi. 
4. Counsel for the State will get 
instructions as to why the petitioner could 
not be adjusted in one of these three places. 
5. List the matter on 21.08.2024. 
6. In the meantime, status quo with 
regard to the transfer order (Annexure-12) 
of the petitioner be maintained. 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.) (Ritu Bahri, C.J.)
 16.08.2024 16.08.2024
